title: Record the producer invariant for restored remote proxies without a queue hash
outcome: Optional Low from Claude R2: wire_session_from_record and wire_session_summary_from_record copy a remote proxy's stored queue_projection_hash verbatim. An obsolete persisted proxy row with None would emit a current DTO without the required field until validated remote refresh. All current remote admission producers supply Some; reviewer explicitly calls this outside current-tree defect scope and covered by development-phase compatibility policy. Resolve the invariant/disposition explicitly without inventing an owner hash, adding an old-protocol compatibility path, or deleting/mutating historical data as an assumed fix.
acceptance: Record source-backed current producer, restore and first-refresh behavior and the explicit disposition of hashless historical proxy rows; if a supported current-input invariant violation is confirmed, repair it through the existing owner with focused regression evidence while keeping historical records readable and avoiding compatibility heuristics.
